record.body:
## Rationale

The area page merges Needs-you items from several efforts. A read-only list that links to the effort keeps every answer and sign-off on one page, the effort page, so the human-gate writes keep one place. The active constraint `dashboard-human-gate-writes` limits dashboard writes, and this does not widen them.

## Counter-argument

Acting from the area page saves a click for each item and shows all pending decisions in one place. The existing Needs-you rows already carry the buttons, so reuse costs little.

payload.alternatives: Full Needs-you actions on the area page
payload.choice: Needs-you on the area page is a read-only list that links to the effort

record.subject: area-needs-read-only
